globalResearchLanes.why: Provider rules expose Bronze/Silver/Gold jackpots on 3/4/5 consecutive identical outcomes; the one-spin overlay is mathematically screenable after a trigger-minus-one streak, but no regulated Spain deployment/partner economics are verified.

Public descriptions use recent/repeated outcomes and roughly a three-spin horizon. On a fair independent RNG any history-only k-number set remains k/37 coverage with negative expectation; synthetic biased controls show the idea can behave as crude anomaly detection, not fair-RNG prediction.

Lightning post-close multipliers block reactive selection; Mega Fire Blaze reduced inside payouts normalize the base component and the bonus/jackpot layer must be modeled from exact rules rather than coverage folklore.
